name: Argent Veil, Shield Bash with Bastion
idea: Argent Veil makes Arbiter's Evade cast Shield Bash every 2 meters. Every Shield Bash counts as a Block, and Bastion of Sir Matthias gives each Block a 15% chance to retaliate with another Shield Bash, which is itself a Block, so the chain feeds itself. Bastion also makes Shield Bash hit 80 to 100% [x] harder and adds a chance to deal double damage.
